checks: Search existing records and update the matching record instead of duplicating it.
Use public, current, direct source URLs over search snippets or old posts.
Record source checkedAt timestamps and claim-specific supports.
Use high confidence and published status only when current sources substantiate the key details; otherwise use candidate status.
Do not invent prices, terms, dates, locations, dietary suitability, or URLs.
Run npm run validate:content when a local checkout is available; otherwise wait for the PR content validation check before claiming acceptance.
submission.agentInstructions: For public or explicitly owner-requested interactive contributions, follow docs/CONTRIBUTING_FINDS.md and the matching mandate. Deduplicate against main and pending contributions. Preserve canonical identity, source evidence, actual check times and researcher attribution. Resume an existing relevant branch or PR rather than creating duplicates. Commit only canonical find JSON and open a non-draft PR to main; allowlisted authors may opt in with agent-content after editorial review. Confirm each completed stage before reporting it. Stop on action-review rejection without changing endpoints to circumvent it. ChatGPT scheduled runs must instead follow scheduledDiscovery: research-only, with no GitHub writes. GitHub Actions is the independent unattended researcher and publisher.

automation.eligibility: Explicitly allowlisted PR authors only; open, non-draft PRs to the default branch adding or modifying at most 25 canonical find JSON files.
automation.editorialResponsibility: The authorised agent must verify all source claims before opting in. Schema validation does not verify factual evidence.

scheduledDiscovery.chatgptInstructions: Fetch docs/CHATGPT_SCHEDULED_DISCOVERY.md each run. Preserve new source-backed proposals in task output. Do not create branches, commit, open PRs, label, merge or retry blocked writes from the ChatGPT schedule. GitHub independently researches and publishes its own validated output.
